versions.versionNote: searchVersion and rankingVersion name the version that produced this frozen capture, which the public clip-search-v1 response returns as searchVersion. OPT2 introduced pleni-search-v3 with candidate-level admission, so this baseline is the v2 before-state of that change and now mirrors SEARCH_RANKING_ROLLBACK_VERSION in supabase/functions/_shared/search/ranking.ts. Relabelling it v3 would falsify which ranking produced the capture. indexVersion and capturedAt are copied from the frozen capture. interpretationYearBasis is the UTC year an unqualified Swedish day-month phrase resolves against; it is pinned here so the baseline cannot drift with the wall clock.
